note: Commit hashes given as original-lineage / integrated-lineage where both exist (rc8-runtime-mode-contract vs integration/rc8-runtime-mode-contract; feat/runtime-fixes vs upstream/openJiuwen-Solar). Corpus cross-references are F-xxx ids in opensolar-failure-corpus.md.

failure_classes.name: Planner DAG nondeterminism
failure_classes.description: The LLM planner invents a fresh graph shape, node ids, capsule bindings, and write_scope path conventions on every run for the same prompt. Each reshuffle exposes a different downstream contract bug.
symptoms: R1-R5 vs S1-S4 vs S1-S5 for the same prompt
capsule binding flips (implementation vs audit) between runs
write_scope emitted with/without workspace/ prefix
a fix verified on run N is bypassed by run N+1's shape
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Workflow contract compiler: known workflow triggers instantiate a fixed, byte-identical stage DAG (deepdive_research variant); the LLM planner is reserved for genuinely novel tasks. See workflow-contract-unification-plan.md.

failure_classes.name: Generic PM decomposition used for deep research
failure_classes.description: Research/report prompts route through should_epic_decompose_request -> PM epic -> software-lifecycle decomposition (requirements/architecture/core-runtime/orchestration-ui/verification-release), which is semantically wrong for research deliverables.
symptoms: deep-research prompt produces S01_requirements..S05_verification_release children
PRD/architecture gates block a report task
zero research artifacts despite long runtimes
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Restore the dropped DeepDive front door (deepdive_requirement_compiler: is_explicit_deepdive_request + build_deepdive_evidence_dag) as the first instance of the workflow-contract router; research triggers never enter PM epic decomposition.

failure_classes.name: Epic over-decomposition for small artifact tasks
failure_classes.description: Bounded single-artifact tasks are decomposed into 5-child engineering epics, multiplying every orchestration risk by 5 and adding PRD/architecture gates the task does not need.
symptoms: single report request becomes 5 sprints
30-min timeouts with the epic still on child 1
oversize epic noted in paperfilter validation
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Workflow contract declares its own stage list; epic decomposition becomes an explicit workflow kind with an admission rule (size/scope threshold), not the default for everything.

failure_classes.name: Operator/capsule/task_type admission mismatch
failure_classes.description: The task_type submitted to capsule admission is derived from the wrong authority (logical-operator name, freeform label, alias) instead of the resolved capsule's admitted set. Four distinct instances: analysis->audit_inventory, tests->implementation, implementationworker (logical-op name), logical-op-map vs resolved-audit-capsule.
symptoms: admission_failed: task_type not allowed: <x>
operator_pool_submit_failed followed by silent pane fallback pane_not_idle
node stuck assigned with no escalation
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Single source of truth: dispatch task_type comes from the workflow contract stage entry, validated at compile time against the capsule's task_type_in set. A non-admitted type is a compile error, never a runtime pane fallback.

failure_classes.name: Artifact/report node bound to implementation patch-diff proof
failure_classes.description: Nodes whose write_scope is data/report artifacts only (json/md/html) get bound to cap.requirement-compiler-implementation whose proof contract requires patch_diff + patch_within_scope, which a no-code node can never satisfy.
symptoms: S1-patch_diff_not_emitted.json reason=patch_diff_not_emitted_no_write_scope_targets
proof gate FAIL on proof.patch_diff_exists for a report node
repair budget exhausted, node terminal failed, downstream skipped
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Proof obligations keyed by artifact type in the workflow contract: report/artifact stages carry output_present obligations on their declared artifacts; patch_diff obligations exist only on stages whose contract declares code outputs. Outside bounded mode this is still unfixed.

failure_classes.name: Missing/undiscoverable patch proof for code tasks
failure_classes.description: Code nodes legitimately require patch proof but the runtime failed three ways: workers did not emit the sidecar, the dispatcher could not discover node-scoped patch filenames, and sidecar-shaped obligations were not honored by the emitter.
symptoms: live smoke fails on missing S1-patch.diff
repair writes a real patch but evaluator still reports it missing
false-positive fallback marked patch present from handoff+write_scope
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Per-node artifact manifest written by the dispatcher after build/repair; proof evaluation reads the manifest, not filename guesses. Manifest becomes part of the workflow contract's proof section.

failure_classes.name: Proof obligation mismatch by artifact type
failure_classes.description: The proof-obligation set is derived from the capsule static default rather than from what the stage actually produces; includes research_quality_gate demanding research_eval_json that the flow never produced.
symptoms: research_quality_gate ok=false errors=[research_eval_json_missing:...]
proof gate demands artifacts the node type cannot produce
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Obligations declared per stage in the contract; the compiler rejects a stage whose obligations reference artifacts not in the stage's declared outputs or gate inputs.

failure_classes.name: Evaluator capacity / singleton contention / human-review gate
failure_classes.description: Eval dispatch has no capacity model: zero evaluators caused infinite silent retries; a busy singleton evaluator was classified as absent and consumed the escalation budget; escalation lands on needs_human_review which dependency-blocks the whole DAG.
symptoms: 246x graph_eval_dispatch_failed reason=no_available_evaluator
eval_dispatch_failures 8/8 last_eval_reason=evaluator_temporarily_busy
needs_human_review terminalizes all downstream nodes
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Contract declares evaluator gates per stage including gate kind (llm-eval vs deterministic), capacity requirement, wait-vs-escalate policy, and whether human-review blocks dependents. Deterministic gates (research eval-artifacts) replace LLM evaluators where the contract allows.

failure_classes.name: Sticky auto-resolution failure
failure_classes.description: A policy decision (auto-resolved warning-pass) was stored as a status value that other subsystems (quality gate, repair path, reconcile) could clobber via direct status writes, so the decision did not survive closeout.
symptoms: passed_with_review_warning flips to failed_review with no new content verdict
_start_node_repair_from_eval_fail direct-writes status bypassing rank guard
auto-resolution event fires repeatedly
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Never live-verified end-to-end. Structural fix: gate decisions are append-only ledger records owned by the contract runner; node status is a projection of the ledger, and no subsystem writes status directly.

failure_classes.name: Mechanical evaluator FAIL (missing gate input) mistaken for content FAIL
failure_classes.description: An evaluator verdict of FAIL whose only cause is a missing mechanical input (research_eval_json) is indistinguishable, in the stored verdict, from a genuine content/evidence failure.
symptoms: verdict=FAIL with failed_conditions=[research_quality_gate] only and acceptance D1/D2/D3 all PASS
repair triggered against valid content
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Eval verdict schema must separate verdict_kind: content|mechanical|infrastructure, set by the gate runner, not inferred afterwards by string inspection.

failure_classes.name: Content evaluator FAIL on closeout/evidence nodes (true positives)
failure_classes.description: Builders underperform on review/evidence/closeout nodes (stale handoff, malformed YAML); the evaluator correctly fails them. Repeated across Run F N3, Run G S3, gap register G14.
symptoms: closeout node fails all acceptance criteria while upstream products are sound
malformed review_decision.yaml
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Closeout stages get deterministic validator commands in the contract (parse YAML/JSON, freshness checks) so builders self-check before eval; the class narrows but builder prompt quality remains a quality track.

failure_classes.name: Repair lifecycle race
failure_classes.description: Repair, eval, and parent-closure run concurrently without a shared generation: parent graphs terminalize during active repair; duplicate repair builders dispatch for one node; direct status writes bypass the state machine.
symptoms: parent terminalized while repair/re-eval active
multiple builder results for the same repair window
failed_review written directly
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Live repair has never been exercised end-to-end in a green run. Contract runner owns a per-node generation counter; every eval/repair/closure actor must present the current generation to write.

failure_classes.name: Stale eval generation / stale sidecar race
failure_classes.description: Canonical <node>-eval.json/md files are keyed only by node, so late pre-repair evaluator output or scheduler doctor backfill repopulates them after repair and reconcile treats stale evidence as current.
symptoms: eval JSON generated_by=graph_scheduler.doctor generation_mode=repair_backfill postdating repair
STALE_ARCHIVED eval_generation_mismatch 0!=1
repaired node failed by pre-repair evidence
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Generation-stamped eval artifacts are now enforced; the contract schema should make eval_generation a required field of every gate record so new gates cannot regress.

failure_classes.name: Wrapper epic observation bug
failure_classes.description: The live E2E wrapper watched only the parent epic status and could not see child-sprint node states, so epic runs looked like opaque hangs.
symptoms: 30-minute polls showing only parent active
no per-child node/operator visibility
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Wrapper reads the same contract the runtime executes: expected stages, artifacts, and terminal states come from the workflow contract file, not wrapper-side heuristics.

failure_classes.name: Wrapper validation timing race
failure_classes.description: Artifact validation fired on file presence while the producing node was still reviewing, validating mid-draft content (transient TODO) 18ms before the final write.
symptoms: PLACEHOLDER_CONTENT: found 'TODO' while final file is clean
VALIDATOR_FAILED with producers still active
fixed_by_commits: fd83ee51 (producer-completion gate + file stability + INCOMPLETE state)
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Contract declares per-stage terminal states; validators run only when the producing stage is terminal. Verified live in v9 (47 polls pending, no premature fire).

failure_classes.name: Workspace/workdir artifact-root mismatch
failure_classes.description: Artifact root is a convention, not a contract: planner emits write_scope with or without workspace/ prefix, builder cwd is the sprint workdir, wrapper expects the shared workspace; valid artifacts get reported missing.
symptoms: expected_artifacts_missing while validator passes on sprints/<sid>/workdir/...
deliverables landing in harness root (earlier form)
fixed_by_commits: 1240285a (wrapper multi-root resolution; runtime writer intentionally unchanged)
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: artifact_roots is a first-class contract field (canonical root + allowed aliases + publish/export step); the runtime writer, not just the wrapper, must honor it. Runtime-side normalization is still owner-gated.

failure_classes.name: Route-proof missing for executed child
failure_classes.description: Runs that die before the route-proof capture stage produce no provider evidence at all, so failed runs cannot even prove what ran.
symptoms: route-proof ABSENT because S3/S4 validate node never ran
providers_observed=[] on aborted runs
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Route records must be emitted per stage-execution (append-only), not assembled by a terminal node; a run killed at any point still has complete route evidence for every stage that ran.

failure_classes.name: Route-proof provider violation / route-truth artifacts lie
failure_classes.description: Selected provider was not a hard contract (Run A: labeled Claude, ran OpenAI). Later, execution was correct but artifacts lied: physical-plan selected_operator_id names a Claude operator, host_type=claude_code_session on codex operators.
symptoms: run labeled one provider executes another
physical-plan operator differs from runstate provider
misleading host_type labels
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Route-proof expectations declared in the contract (allowed_providers per stage); plan artifacts must label planner suggestions as suggestions; preflight blocks the run if any stage cannot resolve inside the allowed set.

failure_classes.name: Model alias / operator registry mismatch
failure_classes.description: Codex physical operators existed but model-registry aliases were missing; registry entries are mislabeled (codex operator tagged provider=anthropic), enabled-but-deprecated, or enabled-with-missing-CLI.
symptoms: validate-main gpt-5.5 fails pre-fix
planner-role operator with wrong provider label selected for builds
gemini operators exit 1 but stay selectable
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Registry hygiene (G7/G8): health is the source of truth; deprecated is enforced; dead config (operator-model-selections.json) removed. Contract compiler validates every stage's logical operator against a healthy physical operator at preflight.

failure_classes.name: Auth preservation issue
failure_classes.description: Isolated sandbox E2E lost Codex auth state; fixed by preserving auth files into the sandbox. Auth file contents were not inspected for this corpus; only existence is relevant.
symptoms: codex CLI unauthenticated inside isolated harness
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Preflight check per provider: auth present and valid before run start (fail-closed with actionable reason).

failure_classes.name: Installed harness contamination
failure_classes.description: Clean-proof runs silently used the installed ~/.solar harness: operator shells fell back to ~/.solar/bin/solar-harness; pytest imported installed lib producing false failures; sync scripts clobber local config; builder artifacts appear in the repo root.
symptoms: command-not-found then global fallback in operator shell
pytest failures whose tracebacks import ~/.solar/harness/lib
untracked deliverables (countletters.py, utils.py) in the repo working tree
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Contract runner refuses to start unless HARNESS_DIR/SPRINTS_DIR/PYTHONPATH resolve inside the declared harness; artifact roots must be inside the workflow's declared roots (never the repo checkout).

failure_classes.name: Process cleanup / orphan coordinator / watchdog / tmux residue
failure_classes.description: Wrapper cleanup kills its tmux sessions but not coordinator/watchdog daemons; the watchdog respawns the coordinator; orphan codex_operator processes and stale schedulers burn quota after runs end.
symptoms: coordinator survives first kill (respawned)
codex_operator.py residue in cleanup listings
3 leftover multi-task schedulers found days later
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Run-scoped process registry: every daemon started for a run registers (pid, role, run_id); teardown kills by registry, watchdog respects a run-terminal marker. This has never had a dedicated fix.

failure_classes.name: Dashboard readiness gap / status projection untruth
failure_classes.description: Dashboard/product projections disagree with graph truth: parent status active after all nodes passed; usage shows 0 during real model calls; operator state split-brain between status-server and operator_runtime; demo Track A blocked on runtime.
symptoms: status.json active while task_graph terminal passed
Usage 0 with real Codex calls
UI shows leased operator the selector already recovered
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Dashboard renders the contract: stage list with dashboard_labels, gate states from the ledger, route proof, and artifact manifest. No independent recomputation of operator/run state.

failure_classes.name: Setup wizard / installer integration gap
failure_classes.description: feature/setup-wizard is behind upstream with 0 commits ahead and not integrated; stale-harness sync, persona symlink, node_modules preflight, PEP-668, macOS bootstrap, WSL2 first-run each broke artifact installs; browser dashboard can bypass the Electron preload gate until a server-side setup gate exists.
symptoms: new artifact serves old runtime
macOS/Windows build failures on private symlink
fresh WSL distro missing, port null
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Keep as a separate packaging track (no-touch for the workflow-contract work); artifact acid tests per OS remain the release gate.

failure_classes.name: Report quality / boilerplate / shallow synthesis
failure_classes.description: The deep-research synthesizer emits hardcoded boilerplate as the report body regardless of topic; PM scaffold PRDs lack most schema sections; evaluator acceptance criteria drift stricter than the user prompt.
symptoms: report body identical across topics
prd.md missing 7 of 11 sections
eval fails on requirements the prompt never made
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Content quality is gated per stage by deterministic checks the contract names (citation accuracy, unsupported-claim rate via research eval-artifacts); the synthesizer boilerplate must be fixed before the DeepDive engine fronts the demo.

failure_classes.name: Self-incriminating report/demo wording
failure_classes.description: Generated deliverables contain wording that fails validators or undermines the demo: a report sentence containing the word placeholder tripped the placeholder regex; transient TODO drafts; deliverables admitting 'No web access granted'.
symptoms: validator false-positive on self-referential cleanliness claims
TODO visible in mid-draft
deliverable text admits missing capability
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Contract's export stage includes a wording lint (no capability disclaimers in customer-facing artifacts unless the run is a declared blocker report); builders receive the validator's exact token list in their stage brief.

failure_classes.name: No live workers / operational capacity invisible
failure_classes.description: Configured operators are not running workers; selecting a runtime does not guarantee live capacity; runs queue forever on worker_capacity_exhausted.
symptoms: worker_capacity_exhausted with ~30 idle configured operators
multi_task_session missing, 0 live workers
builder pane needs_respawn loop
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Preflight includes live-capacity check per stage role; the contract runner may auto-start the pool for the declared roles or fail-closed with remediation.

failure_classes.name: Coordinator/runtime supervision faults
failure_classes.description: Self-complete tick segfaulted (rc=139, Python 3.13 readline/locale) with unusable failure evidence; stale operator leases with dead PIDs; fresh eval assignments closed by stale results; S01 role-pool inflight suppression had no timeout.
symptoms: rc=139 with empty output
runtime_state=running with dead PIDs
planner_role_pool_inflight forever
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Every in-flight suppression/lease/assignment carries a heartbeat + bounded timeout; supervision failures write structured snapshots. 8341fc5a is deterministic-verified only, never live-revalidated.

failure_classes.name: Gate consumes node status, not verdict content
failure_classes.description: Review/parent gates certified when member nodes reached 'passed' status, never reading the verdict artifacts those nodes produced - so a critic verdict=block or verifier decision=FAIL was ignored and a sprint could auto-close and export against its own reviewers' objections.
symptoms: critic node passed while contradictions.jsonl gate_verdict=block
verifier node passed while verifier_decision.json decision=FAIL
transient pass auto-closed and exported with coverage=0 before revert
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Gates read ledger verdict records (author+content), fail-closed when an expected verdict artifact is missing; schema-locked so new gates cannot regress (R4).

failure_classes.name: Verdict provenance not structural (self-graded / doctor-backfilled evals)
failure_classes.description: The structured eval.json that gates consume could be written by the scheduler doctor (repair_backfill) or reflect a self-graded builder verdict with no independent eval report - a latent hollow-pass vector, safe only under manual .md review.
symptoms: eval.json generation_mode=repair_backfill
thin eval.json (reasons null, has_evidence false) while eval.md holds the real reasoning
executor node with verdict but no independent eval report
representative_runs: research3 S1 (mode=None slipped the narrow fix)
failure_classes.recommended_contract_fix: Ledger records carry author, generation, and evidence snapshot; the evaluator writes its own verdict record at eval time; any backfill is flagged and never gate-consumable (R4).
